name: weekly-fetch
description: iPhone and Android app shells (Capacitor) for The Weekend Fetch. The website itself needs none of this.

scripts.app:build: python3 src/build_app.py && npx cap sync ios
scripts.app:release: WF_RELEASE=1 python3 src/build_app.py && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android:build: python3 src/build_app.py && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:release: WF_RELEASE=1 python3 src/build_app.py && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.test:db: node supabase/tests/test_groups.mjs && node supabase/tests/test_analytics.mjs && node supabase/tests/test_apple_revoke.mjs
